messages:
jamal: Quick pulse on Q3 shiplane milestones — calling owners and any slips/risks. Who's got updates on the feature gating and infra side?
maria: Frontend shipped the bulk of the UI last week. Remaining: analytics hook + a11y fixes. ETA EOD Thursday. PR: https://github.com/redwood/shiplane/pull/487
alex: Backend feature toggle is in canary; latency bump + small DB migration. Migration is reversible; deployment blocked on infra readiness for the migration window.
sophia: Eng infra — we need a short maintenance window for the migration. Can we target Sat 02:00 UTC? Will require oncall presence.
jamal: @sophia Sat 02:00 UTC works for product cadence. @alex can you post the migration steps here (brief)?
alex: migration plan:
```
1) create new column (non-blocking)
2) backfill script (throttled)
3) switch toggle
4) drop legacy idx after 48h
```
Backfill should be rate-limited to avoid load spikes.
prashant: FYI I put a patch for the cache invalidation bug in staging — needs review. @maria can you take a quick look? https://github.com/redwood/shiplane/pull/489
maria: Reviewing now, should be a 15m read.
deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance created: 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z (ID: maint-9123)
jamal: Ok next: ownership clarifications — who will own rollout monitoring and rollback criteria?
sophia: Infra will own rollout monitoring (latency, error rate, CPU). Rollback criteria: error rate > 1.5% sustained for 5m or p50 latency > 300ms. We'll alert on both.
alex: Product-specified quality checks: end-to-end checkout smoke must pass in prod traffic sample before toggle. If smoke fails, we rollback immediately.
jamal: Last: blockers. Anything likely to slip past Sat window?
prashant: If a11y fixes don't clear by Thursday EOD, they won't block rollout if a small flag is set; but we should track a follow-up ticket.
maria: Agree — I'll file a post-launch cleanup ticket and mark the items non-blocking for launch.
jamal: Actions:
- @alex: finalize migration runbook + staging dry-run by Fri EOD
- @sophia: confirm oncall rotation for Sat window by Thu
- @maria: land analytics hook or file post-launch cleanup by Thu EOD
- @prashant: finish review and merge cache fix today
I'll update the OKR spreadsheet after merges. :thumbsup:
prashant: noted, will ping when merged.
jamal: Thanks all — I'll post a final sync message Friday morning. :rocket:
